column1: # kind<TAB>name<TAB>slots<TAB>verdict. The slot table of the order contract: every operation that writes page state, the slots it can touch, and who may write them.
# kind method: a row of METHODS in ts/bridge.ts (slots must equal its `slots` list); verdict forbidden: no Rust outside primitives/src/bridge/ names its Method variant (the slot has an owner).
# kind write: a row of WRITES (a slot Rust may write, fenced by based_on); verdict rust.
# kind effect: a row of APPLY (what a decision's effect writes on the page); verdict page: only the adapter writes it.
# Slots: open, focus, scroll, caret, attr, style. A row is added with the operation that needs it; scripts/check-bridge-behaviours.sh holds the table equal to the three sources.
